name: Train Depot
summary: Beneath Gnomeregan's entrance in Dun Morogh, the Train Depot lies overrun by leper gnomes and troggs. Once, its rails carried gnomes through the city. Now the depot is in ruin.

sections.title: A Ruined Transit Hub
sections.body: Beneath the grand elevator from Dun Morogh, the Train Depot's platforms and tracks lie in ruin. Once, rail lines carried gnomes through Gnomeregan. Radiation swept through the city and changed the workers who remained into crazed leper gnomes. Troggs from below have overrun the rails. You must cross the depot to reach deeper parts of the city, including Clockwerk Run, the Loading Room, and the inner engineering facilities.

faq.q: Where is the Train Depot located?
aliases: how to get to train depot
faq.answer: The Train Depot lies beneath the surface entrance elevator in Dun Morogh, before Gnomeregan's inner parts.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Train Depot now?
faq.answer: Feral troggs from deep underground and leper gnomes driven mad by the radioactive disaster overrun the depot.

faq.q: Where do the paths from the Train Depot lead?
faq.answer: Passages lead west into Clockwerk Run and toward the Loading Room. A northern workshop's back door leads down to the upper Engineering Labs.

faq.q: Who is hiding in the Train Depot?
faq.answer: Namdo Bizzfizzle, an engineering supplier, survives beneath the north side of the main platform on the depot's lower level.

angles.text: As an exiled gnome, you see the abandoned depot as a reminder of the advanced rail systems that once joined your subterranean city.
As an engineer, you can search the depot's lower platforms for rare schematics. Gnome peddlers such as Namdo Bizzfizzle still trade among the wreckage.
